answer: Every identity registers a terrace plot, locks 70 credits, and each epoch, inside a 15-minute tide window, files a key-signed river reading. Auditors replay the registry and gauge; late, reused, or 5% off burns it. No operator can cover two terrace plots at once, so each fake needs a rented stand-in: first 40, k-th 40+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000, lock 70,000, for a 40,000 pool. A stand-in signing twice voids both. Honest agents pay 40 once.
